page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 295 at right. Main text in one column with marginal-free layout; below the text, a signature-like mark "N 4" and catchword "5. Quid" at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Id quod procedit, si in conditionali statuto conditio non servetur, modo talis sit conditio, quae formam internam det statuto, adeoque necessaria sit, ut vel ex verbis, vel intentione statuentis, inesse aut adesse debeat. Barbos. in axiom. jur. verb. forma. Baldus in Auth. matri. Cod. quando. mul. off. tutel. Tiraquell. de Retract. § 1. gloss. 21. n. 13. Bartol. in l. 1. n. 9. D. Condit. & Demonstr.

Idem quod ut plurimum servatur, si statuta contineant ablativos absolutos, quę saepissime inferunt aliquam necessitatem. l. evictis agris. D. de Evict. l. testatore. D. Condit. & demonstr. vid. Boer. ad Bituricens. tit. 8. §. 1. p. 109. Chassan. ad Burgund. Rubric. 7. §. 5. in textum. Ne peut faire. n. 1. 2. Mascard. conclus. 9. n. 2. 3. 4. & seqq. n. 19. & seqq. Zoes. D. de legibus, n. 47. 48. 49. 50. Sanden. 2. def. 6. tit. 1. Vinnius Select. quaest. 1.
main_text.head: SECT. VIII. CAP. II.
main_text.p: 1. Utrum statuta laicorum, uti loquuntur personas ligent ecclesiasticas?
2. Utrum cives Academici, territorii statutis ligentur?
4. Quid de Principe statuendum, & ejus familitio?

page.notes: Lower part of the page is faint; the heading line "SECT. VIII. CAP. II." and the numbered questions are reproduced as printed. Items 1 to 4 are questions set in italic with roman numerals; the "N 4" mark and "5. Quid" are at the foot. Some words in the Latin citations are doubtful due to scan quality.
